_comment: "When this hits, you may put an ITEM WITH COST 0 OR 1 from your hand INTO THE ARENA." It was two PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM nodes -- the BOTTOM OF THE DECK, the opposite of the arena -- each gated on CARD_IN_ZONE zone:hand cost:0 / cost:1, and 'cost' was not a key CARD_IN_ZONE read (it reads cost_gte/cost_lte), so both gates asked only whether the hand was non-empty. The result was that hitting with Metex put TWO arbitrary cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck: not a weaker version of the printed effect but a punishing one, and mandatory where the card says 'you may'. Boost is a printed keyword.
